paragraphs.text: The Sword of the Animist , also known as the Stem Sword and Bitterthorn while under compleation , is a legendary artifact sword wielded by the planeswalker Nissa Revane .

The Sword of the Animist or Stem Sword is a concealed weapon hidden within the Nissa Revane's staff. It is a thin blade with a sharp point, a design optimized for stabbing over cutting. It channels mana into the wounds it causes, which can cause vines to sprout from the wounds. The staff was later fused into her skin as a right arm during her Compleation, while the sword became Bitterthorn - a Phyrexian living weapon . The sword and staff were later cleansed of their oil during her un-compleation.
